text:
maya: FYI: We're cutting over billing aggregation from per-minute to hourly on 2026-05-12. This affects invoice line items and CSV exports only. Rate limits/enforcement remain per-minute.

zane: Important: does this change overage thresholds or math?

maya: Overage math stays the same; it will be applied to hourly buckets. Invoices will include an extra column showing peak-minute within each hour for transparency.

finance-bot: RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfc/hourly-billing-2026. Key bits: 1) hourly invoice lines; 2) "credit-smoothing" so trials don't burn faster; 3) 90-day minute-mode export via support.

billing-team: We'll review contracts for Dedicated customers and flag any clauses that reference minute-line items.

ops: Concern: backfill/ingest causing dashboard lag?

maya: Backfills run in a separate queue. Staging with hourly aggregation available 2026-04-18 for ops validation.

support: Can support request minute-level exports for investigations?

finance-bot: Yes, support can provision minute-mode exports for up to 90 days on request after cutover.

alex: Requesting a partner-facing FAQ and a 14-day console toggle to revert invoice generation if needed.

maya: We'll add a revert toggle (14-day window) with audit logging. Billing + comms: please sign off RFC by 2026-04-15. I'll post simulation results after the dry-run. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
